# Time-boxed pip-audit exceptions — one per line:
#
#   <VULN_ID> <expiry YYYY-MM-DD> <why waiting is acceptable>
#
# Example:
#   GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz 2026-09-01 fix needs langchain-core 1.5, pinned until eval re-run
#
# CI fails the moment an entry expires, so nothing here is permanent.
# An entry without an expiry date also fails the build.

PYSEC-2026-311 2026-11-01 chromadb (CVE-2026-45829): pre-auth code injection in the chroma HTTP SERVER (/api/v2 collections endpoint) — ragstone never runs that server; it uses the embedded PersistentClient only (src/ragstone/rag/vector_db.py, re-verified 2026-09-04: PersistentClient is the only chromadb client constructed), so the vulnerable surface is never started. Re-checked at the first expiry, 2026-09-04: still no fixed release (OSV last_affected 1.5.9 = the latest on PyPI; OSV record unchanged since 2026-07-01); chroma is legacy-tier, not the default store. At this expiry: re-check OSV again; if still none, retire the chroma store rather than renew a third time (maintainer decision).
CVE-2026-45830 2026-11-01 chromadb (GHSA-2wm9-hf6c-p5cr): missing tenant authorization in the chroma HTTP SERVER — any authenticated server user can read/write other tenants' collections. Same surface as PYSEC-2026-311: ragstone runs no chroma server, exposes no tenants and has no authenticated remote users; the embedded PersistentClient is the only client constructed. Published 2026-06-12, surfaced in pip-audit 2026-09-04, no fixed release (last_affected = 1.5.9, the latest). Same expiry and same retire-or-renew decision as the entry above.
CVE-2026-45831 2026-11-01 chromadb (GHSA-xph7-9rjv-w5fr): SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider in the chroma HTTP SERVER checks the permission but not the tenant/database/collection it applies to. ragstone never configures a chroma authorization provider and never runs the server. No fixed release as of 2026-09-04. Same expiry and decision as PYSEC-2026-311.
CVE-2026-45833 2026-11-01 chromadb (GHSA-36p7-vc44-83pf): authenticated code injection through the chroma HTTP SERVER's /api/v2 .../collections/{id} endpoint (malicious model repository with trust_remote_code). ragstone never runs the server and never sets trust_remote_code; the embedded PersistentClient only reads its own local store. No fixed release as of 2026-09-04. Same expiry and decision as PYSEC-2026-311.
